reviews.reviewbody: u might want to look at the episode guide to this series on bing
I think this is all the ones extant on here, tbh, unless someone sneaky uploaded a few new ones since 2018. Thanks for organizing it.
Thank you so much for uploading these. I was wondering if you happen to have the original uncompressed files that these videos are sourced from.
Episodes are not complete asmany are missing, big chunks of entire seasons. Had the OP took some time and a little work getting them from YouTube he might have had a decent little download here.

Those who comment the set is incomplete do not understand that most of the episodes are not released and are believed lost.  I did notice Pluto is streaming season 8 episode 38 which is not in your list. So it may be out there as a downloadable file.
I always loved the frank commentary between the detectives; priceless!

This collection is much appreciated, thanks.
Dragnet was a high concept cop show with more personality and psychology than violence,
Many great actors and actresses -- indeed some particularly beautiful women -- played roles of witnesses and, importantly, criminals. Their names are in the end credits.
Check them out on imdb.com and marvel at their vast careers in TV and movies. Imagine Hollywood in the 1950s and the crowd of talent appearing in all the hot shows.

The only one you’re missing form your post is S03E21 The Big Boys: https://archive.org/details/TheBigBoys
This one features a quick appearance by Leonard Nimoy…enjoy!

October 12, 2023

For those who might be interested in correct information:
Upon viewing this collection of Dragnet episodes, I realized three were repeated and mistitled. I also discovered Six other episodes have been mistitled as well. Notification of this information will be made to originally submitted it. If corrections can be made this post can be disregarded or removed. 

Repeated and mistitled episodes are:
S05E09 - The Big Bird is a repeat of S04E03 - The Big Crime
S05E13 - The Big Shot is a repeat of S03E28 - The Big Shoplift
S05E23 - The Big Child is a repeat of S03E24 - The Big Children

Other mistitled episodes are:
S03E19 - The Big Trunk is a mistitled episode of S05E09 - The Big Bird
S03E35 - The Big Plant is a mistitled episode of S05E05 - The Big Confession
S04E01 - The Big Producer is a mistitled episode of S04E18 - The Big Rod
S04E18 - The Big Rod is a mistitled episode of  S04E01 - The Big Producer
S05E12 - The Big Bounce is a mistitled episode of  S04E23 - The Big TV
S06E12 - The Big Doting Mother is a mistitled episode of S01E04 - The Big Mother
Is Dragnet now public domain? if so may I have permission to use the episodes for YouTube?

The only correction I would make to your Corrected Information list is that #34 identified on Archive as 3.35 The Big Plant is actually 3.39 The Big False Make (Wed June 3, Robbery) and not 5.05 The Big Confession which I've never seen on any public domain collection or broadcast.
This is a great collection of the tv series. There are some discrepancies as has been pointed out in other reviews, but other than that... fantastic. Much appreciated.
